terms.meaning: a softly lit, slightly see-through look for a surface.
empty space between the edge of a box and the content inside it.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Setup for the card
sections.what: Brings in the layout, gradient, theme and shadow pieces the card uses.
sections.why: Standard setup at the top of a component file.

sections.name: GlassCardProps
sections.title: Options for the card
sections.what: Lists the options: content, look (default, elevated, outlined or gradient), padding, corner size, extra style and gradient colors.
sections.why: Makes the card's options explicit for anyone using it.
sections.watch_out: Padding and corner size must be names from the shared lists, otherwise they are silently ignored.

sections.name: GlassCard (part 1)
sections.title: Drawing the card
sections.what: Draws a gradient card if one is asked for. Otherwise draws a solid card: default with a thin border, elevated with a shadow, or outlined with a see-through background.
sections.why: Gives the app several card looks from one component.
sections.watch_out: Passing gradient colors switches the card to gradient even when the look says default.

sections.name: GlassCard (part 2)
sections.title: Card styles
sections.what: Defines the faint outer border of gradient cards and the layer that keeps the content above the gradient.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps content visible above the gradient background.

summary: A rounded card with a frosted-glass look, available as plain, elevated, outlined or gradient.
purpose: Gives content a consistent card surface across screens.
why: Likely reason: cards are used widely and should look alike.
how: Sets corner roundness and padding from the chosen options. If a gradient is asked for, it draws a gradient card. Otherwise it draws a solid card in the chosen style, then places the content on top.
inputs: Child content, a variant name, padding and corner keys, extra style, and optional gradient colors.
outputs: A card containing the content. No data handling.
risks: Passing gradient colors overrides the chosen variant. Padding and corner options must be known keys, or they are silently ignored.
debug: If a card has no padding, check the padding key. If a card looks flat when you expected a gradient, check whether gradient colors were passed.
